title: [Bug] Anthropic API Error: Long context beta unavailable for Max plan with Claude Opus 4.6 1M
body:
**Bug Description**
Max plan subscriber getting "The long context beta is not yet available for this subscription" error when using /model claude-opus-4-6[1m]. Opus 4.6 1M context was announced today (Feb 5, 2026) and should be available on Max plans. Same issue previously reported for Sonnet in GitHub issues #6871, #10219, #15057. Request ID: req_011CXrwxYTxjy3wbnMqsZn4N

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: ghostty
- Version: 2.1.34
- Feedback ID: a887216d-a564-4bb1-b9a8-a4017a730aa9

Same issue here. Max 20x subscriber, Claude Code latest version.

- Model: claude-opus-4-6[1m]

- Error: "The long context beta is not yet available for this subscription."

- Request ID: req_011CY5H1nsEiaoqCwhTfd2H3

- Platform: Windows WSL

- Claude Code version: 2.1.41

Contacted Anthropic support — they confirmed the feature is in "limited beta" even within Max 20x, and couldn't enable it or provide a timeline. Escalated to human support, waiting for response.
